messages:
rachel: bumping into a weird install/onboarding flow on macOS Ventura. installed redwoodctl via brew, `redwoodctl login` opens browser for SSO but after auth the CLI prints 'auth retry required' and then drops me into an infinite device-code loop. anyone seen mac-specific SSO loops?
omar: hm, we've seen the oauth redirect URI mismatch on macs when users have an old redwoodctl symlink pointing to /usr/local/bin from a prior brew cask. what's `which redwoodctl`?
rachel: `/opt/homebrew/bin/redwoodctl` (Apple silicon) but i also had an old `/usr/local/bin/redwoodctl` symlink lying around from a manual install. removed it but issue persisted.
jing: could be the CLI detecting installed desktop vs headless by checking tty and choosing device-flow vs browser-flow. on mac the default browser flow launches but the callback may be handled by an older binary on PATH (if a stale copy existed). check `mdls -name kMDItemCFBundleIdentifier $(which redwoodctl)`?
omar: also check `ls -l /usr/local/bin | grep redwoodctl` and `brew unlink redwoodctl && brew link --overwrite redwoodctl`. Sometimes shell completions point to old installs too and `exec` wraps.
rachel: i did `brew unlink redwoodctl && brew link --overwrite redwoodctl` and restarted terminal. got past the loop but then `redwoodctl completion zsh` failed with `zsh compinit: insecure directories` and refused to write. so now install is half-broken because completion can't update.
jing: zsh compinit error usually from wrong perms on `/usr/local/share/zsh/site-functions` or your `$fpath`. run `compaudit` to see insecure dirs and `chmod go-w` on them. brew usually fixes with `sudo chown -R $(whoami):admin /usr/local/share/zsh`.
omar: quick workaround for completions: `redwoodctl completion zsh > ~/.zfunc/_redwoodctl && fpath=(~/.zfunc $fpath) && autoload -Uz compinit && compinit` — avoids touching system dirs. we should document that in mac onboarding.
rachel: thanks, that workaround helps local dev. one last thing: `redwoodctl local-serve` on mac sometimes binds to the loopback but the app (Electron test harness) can't reach it due to mac firewall prompts. had to allow node process in System Preferences. any ideas to detect/advise?
jing: CLI can detect macos firewall status via `socketfilterfw --getglobalstate` and print a hint about opening the port or using `--bind 0.0.0.0` for local testing. please file a small DX issue for: stale-symlink SSO loop, zsh completion permission guidance, and mac firewall hint for local-serve.
devx-bot: created ticket #4890: "macOS onboarding: stale redwoodctl symlink causes SSO callback to hit old binary; zsh compinit perms for completions; firewall hints for local-serve" assigned to @jing.
rachel: will add the brew/link/completion/firewall notes to the mac onboarding page and test the PR when ready. thanks! :rocket:
